name: nonprofit
description: Merrymeeting Bay Community Services, Inc. (fictional) nonprofit fund accounting: the restricted and unrestricted funds, every expense tagged by fund, program and functional classification, amounts released from donor restriction, the balance-sheet snapshot, the net asset balances by restriction class, and federal award spending. Synthetic demo data; all money in integer cents. No donor PII is exposed; the controls reconcile funds, releases and expenses by fund, line and program code only.
domain: nonprofit restricted funds: donor restrictions, functional expenses, net assets and federal awards
notes: A RESTRICTED fund may be spent only for its purpose_code and only inside [window_start, window_end]; an expense charged to it with a different program_code, or dated outside the window, is spending outside the restriction. An UNRESTRICTED fund carries the sentinel purpose_code 'GENERAL' and an open window, and the restricted-spending control ignores it.

An amount released from donor restriction (restriction_releases.released_cents) for a fund must not exceed the qualifying spending for that fund: expenses whose program_code equals the fund's purpose_code and whose expense_date is inside the fund's window. A release ahead of qualifying spending is a finding.

Expenses carry both a natural classification (nature_code: SALARIES, GRANTS, OCCUPANCY, SUPPLIES) and a functional classification (function_class: PROGRAM, MGMT_GENERAL, FUNDRAISING). ASC 958 requires expenses analyzed by both; the nature x function grid must sum to total expenses and carry no negative cell.

net_assets reports balances in ASC 958's two classes, WITH_DONOR_RESTRICTIONS and WITHOUT_DONOR_RESTRICTIONS, as of a snapshot date. Liquid assets (account_balances rows with account_type CASH or INVESTMENT) at that date must be at least the WITH_DONOR_RESTRICTIONS balance, or restricted money has been spent into operations.

single-audit-threshold sums federal_awards.expended_cents for a fiscal year against the Single Audit trigger (2 CFR 200.501), a threshold_cents parameter defaulting to 100,000,000 cents ($1,000,000, raised from $750,000 for fiscal years beginning on or after October 1, 2024). The threshold is data, so an OMB change is a parameter or version bump, not new SQL.
The donor_pii table (donor names, addresses and individual gift histories) is intentionally omitted: this engine never reads donor PII. The controls identify funds and programs by code only.
